page.title: The story behind the atmosphere.
page.introduction: A considered collection shaped by a lasting fascination with fragrance, refined for the rooms we live in.

chapters.heading: Born from fragrance
chapters.body: Infusion Diffusion began with a lifelong affair with fragrance, luxury and scent’s power to turn a space into a feeling.

chapters.heading: From more than 130 oils to six fragrances
chapters.body: More than 130 fragrance oils sourced from around the world were explored before the collection was refined to six distinctive room fragrances. The result is a focused cabinet of atmosphere: clear enough to choose with confidence, expressive enough to change the feeling of a room.

chapters.heading: Composed for lived-in rooms
chapters.body: Infusion Diffusion treats scent as a considered part of an interior. Each fragrance is presented with clarity, restraint and a belief that luxury is earned through material detail, proportion and trust.

page.seoDescription: Discover the Infusion Diffusion story, from more than 130 fragrance oils to six fragrances composed for lived-in rooms.
